items.q: And Carmen, who had been married to Klook, and then she married Ike Isaacs.

ctx.x: Yes, in Berlin. Gildo Mahones, who played piano, beautiful person. And Carmen, who had been married to Klook, and then she married Ike Isaacs.
Whose trio backed up Lambert, Hendricks, and Ross on many – or some recordings.
